note: Owned by this stage's agent. Single writer -- never edit another role's file. `completed_tasks[]` holds prior tasks' full approved records, appended only, never edited; the top-level document/version/status/gate/etc. fields always describe whichever task is currently being drafted or reviewed. `exploratory_concepts[]` holds pre-requirements UI exploration that intentionally never went through this role's own gate -- see each entry's `why_not_gated`.

exploratory_concepts.status: exploratory -- never run through this workflow's draft/validate/gate cycle, deliberately
exploratory_concepts.why_not_gated: Built and iterated directly on a claude.ai Design canvas at the human's explicit request ('go with UI change first, look into previous workflows later'), before any locked PRD/story described this behavior. Recording it as a validated, gated ui_ux task would have misrepresented it as backed by requirements it was not backed by at the time.
exploratory_concepts.canvas_note: The canvas evolved through several human-directed rounds on this single artboard (originally named HomePage.dc.html, then consolidated as the canvas's sole Main.dc.html once the human asked to delete the prior feature-siloed screens): (1) two-panel to-do list + chat concept; (2) merged duplicate input boxes into one bottom composer with suggestion chips, added a business-card camera button, added a 'Welcome, John Doe' header; (3) centered/enlarged the welcome header, removed the chat panel's own heading block; (4) rebuilt around a human-supplied user-journey flowchart image: login -> assistant greets the rep and shows a top-5 to-do list with a More button -> clicking a to-do expands that task into the chat -> a fresh message at the bottom (e.g. 'I met with a new customer today named Gayathri from Acme') triggers the assistant to ask follow-up questions to categorize the new contact as a Prospect, Lead, or Qualified Lead, accepting photo/voice-note/notepad input -- at which point every other screen (old separate capture/business-card/result/resolve/profile/Q&A screens) was deleted from the canvas as no longer representative of the intended product.
exploratory_concepts.motivated: This exploratory concept, reviewed and iterated on directly by the human across multiple rounds, is the concrete trigger cited in workflow-1's workflow.json 'reopened' audit entry (2026-09-17T17:48:25Z) and in PRD v1.6's Section 1 / F-8 / F-9 sources. It has no gate, no validation record, and no artifact_manifest entry in this role file by design -- this array exists solely so that citation has something real and inspectable to point at in tracked framework state, closing a traceability gap the shared Validator correctly flagged (V-P10) when reviewing PRD v1.6.
exploratory_concepts.not_yet_done: No formal ui_ux task (e.g. a future TASK-HOME) has been drafted, validated, or gated against this concept. That is expected to follow once PRD v1.6 (or its corrected revision) and matching user stories are themselves gated -- UI/UX design work should trace to locked requirements, not the other way around, and this concept is the reverse of that (UI drove the requirements change) precisely because it was exploratory.
